title: Query Language Sensitivity in Automated Sentiment Scores of LLM Responses
abstract: arXiv:2607.13304v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Automated scores are often used to summarize how large language models describe brands across prompts, providers, and languages. Such scores can vary because the answers differ, because the scoring instrument behaves differently across texts or languages, or for both reasons. We examine this measurement problem in 12,933 responses from a design crossing 20 stored brand labels, eight query languages, three provider aliases, and 15 prompt identifiers. The outcome is the signed winning-class confidence from a multilingual sentiment classifier: neutral winners are coded zero, while positive and negative winners receive signed confidence. A crossed linear mixed model fitted to all responses assigns 26.49% of fitted variance to query language and 1.46% to brand. An exploratory refit after excluding English assigns 5.07% to language and 2.23% to brand. These percentages have different denominators: total fitted variance falls by 65.08

translated_title: 大语言模型回复自动情感评分中的查询语言敏感性
translated_abstract: 自动化评分常被用于概括大语言模型在不同提示词、提供商和语言下描述品牌的方式。这类评分出现差异的原因可能是回答本身不同，也可能是评分工具在不同文本或语言上表现不一致，或者两者兼有。我们在12,933条回复中考察了这一测量问题，这些回复来自一项跨越20个存储品牌标签、8种查询语言、3个提供商别名和15个提示词标识符的实验设计。评估结果为多语言情感分类器输出的带符号获胜类别置信度：中性获胜者编码为零，正面与负面获胜者则获得带符号的置信度。对所有回复拟合的交叉线性混合模型显示，26.49%的拟合方差归因于查询语言，1.46%归因于品牌。在剔除英语后进行的探索性重拟合中，5.07%的方差归因于语言，2.23%归因于品牌。这些百分比具有不同的分母：总拟合方差下降了65.08%。
tldr: 该研究发现大语言模型回复的自动情感评分对查询语言高度敏感——查询语言可解释约26%的拟合方差，远高于品牌因素的影响，且剔除英语后该效应大幅减弱，表明跨语言使用自动化情感评分时需谨慎解读。
en_tdlr: This study shows that automated sentiment scores of LLM responses are highly sensitive to query language, which accounts for about 26% of fitted variance—far more than brand identity—and the effect shrinks substantially when English responses are excluded.
